description: Hovercart pulled left; Gizmo's Garage re-trimmed the hover jets for free
body: The Glidemaster drifted left on the high street. Gizmo re-trimmed the left hover jets in ten minutes, no charge, as part of the coil warranty.
Bought another bottle of starlight syrup at the Lantern Street Apothecary: $12.

description: Sir Fluffington ate a scented candle; Dr. Jellybean said to watch him, no visit needed
body: He ate a lavender candle off the windowsill. Rang Dr. Jellybean: watch for purple smoke, no visit needed unless it lasts past Tuesday.

description: Hovercart passed its annual float inspection at Gizmo's Garage, 41,020 leagues
body: Correction: the odometer read 41,020 leagues, not 41,200. Checked the inspection sticker.
